name: Design Extract
description: Extract any website's complete design system with one command. DTCG tokens, semantic+primitive+composite, MCP server for DipoleML/Cursor/Windsurf, multi-platform emitters (iOS SwiftUI, Android Compose, Flutter, WordPress), Tailwind v4, Figma variables, shadcn/ui, CSS health audit, WCAG remediation, Chrome extension. MIT, Playwright, Node 20+.
